notes.title: We Are In The June Steam Next Fest!
notes.content: [h1]Baseless is headed to Steam Next Fest![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250311/57f6c5a784058bf34e51e3a4bde00b64a8df10c4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]That's right, [i]Baseless[/i] will be part of [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], running from [b]June 9th through June 16th[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]That means you'll be able to [b]download and play our official demo[/b], get a hands-on feel for the gameplay, and experience the breathtaking first zones of Baseless. [/p][p][/p][p]Whether you're here for the Shooting = Movement mechanic, the plethora of vibrant and unique zones, or the satisfaction of decimating every enemy in your path, we can't wait for you to jump in and tell us what [b]you[/b] think of Baseless.[/p][p][/p][p]👉 Make sure to [b]Wishlist[/b] [i]Baseless[/i] so you don’t miss the demo drop![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1129260/Baseless/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thanks for all your support—and see you during Next Fest![/p][p]- Fermenter Games and First Break Labs[/p]
